title: Best Approach - Reclass balances during consolidation
author: Oscar
content: We use Standard (Calc On The Fly Share and Hierarchy Elimination). What type of Rule should we leverage to reclass balances from one account to another during consolidation?
solution_text: Generally speaking, for pure consolidation, member formulas do indeed fit better on individual members; and pulling data is better than pushing. I would probably put the formula on U4#ReclassThis.
